name: chatping
description: Get a sound and/or OS notification when your AI chat (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) needs your input.

chatping.playSound.description: Play a sound when an AI chat needs your attention.

chatping.sendOsNotification.description: Send an OS-level notification when an AI chat needs your attention.

chatping.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) ChatPing's away-reminder timer checks whether VS Code is still unfocused.

chatping.awayReminder.enabled.description: Fire a reminder alert after VS Code has been unfocused for a while. NOT chat-aware — it has no knowledge of Copilot Chat or any other chat's state, it only tracks window focus. Opt-in and off by default.

chatping.awayReminder.afterMinutes.description: Minutes VS Code must be continuously unfocused before the away reminder fires (only used when chatping.awayReminder.enabled is true).

chatping.debugLogging.description: Log detected state changes (focus transitions, away-reminder firings) to the ChatPing output channel.
